source: docs/plans/phase-4.md §4.5 and §11.1, docs/plans/phase-6.md §2.1 (on-demand, us-east-1, Anthropic list prices). Check the AWS Bedrock pricing page before relying on an estimate. Keyed by the exact Bedrock id: the chat evaluation (-Deval.model) and the chat smoke tests refuse a chat model not listed here, and give the app this price for its cost limits; a model not listed gets no estimate.
note: Anthropic prices are the Geo/In-region ones from the Bedrock pricing page, the table that applies to us. inference-profile ids: Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 corrected on 2026-10-29 (Phase 9 step 9a-4; the Global prices, about 10% lower, had been entered). Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5: list prices as of 2026-10-22, entered by the owner; listed but not yet available to this AWS account (access request pending). Cache prices (step 8c), per million tokens of the cached prefix: a read is 0.1x the input price and a write 1.25x (5-minute TTL), for all Claude models; chat asks a model to cache only when both are listed. Titan has none and is never cached. Phase 9 step 9a: the four small open models (Ministral 3 8B and 14B, Gemma 3 12B, gpt-oss-20b) plus Gemma 3 27B and gpt-oss-120b (run 7b), on-demand in us-east-1 under their in-region model ids (none has a US inference profile), entered by the owner on 2026-10-28/29 from the Bedrock pricing page (US East, on-demand, standard tier). They have no cache prices, so chat never asks them to cache.
